text_block_list.text:
The time for summer training camp arrived once again this year.
A summer even more boisterous than usual.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is temporarily back in the country!
She's leaving again soon, so lock down an interview. Quick!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
After winning a French GⅠ, she's a favorite to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
Ngh... At last, the world's best is coming from Japan...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Now King Halo and Grass Wonder
are going head-to-head in the Mainichi Okan!
Let's get footage of both of them!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We also need to keep an eye on Seiun Sky's moves.
Apparently she's doing a prep run at the summer Sapporo Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoa, even in the middle of summer, my rival sure draws a crowd...!

...The corners of my mouth lifted into a smile at the thought of her,
whom I now called my rival instead of just my classmate.
choice_data_list: Still, you fought that same rival at the Takarazuka Kinen, too.
But you also faced that rival in the Takarazuka Kinen

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. And as a result of getting all that attention~...
it got featured right in the spotlight, didn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi declares bid for Kyoto Daishoten!"
Ughhh, they even gave it a whole subheading!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well, you see...
We're already...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Before we get paparazzi'd, let's move somewhere we can focus!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: I heard we'll be starting off our autumn with the Kyoto Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
"With ability like yours,
you could have headed straight for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
Why did you choose to run a prep race!?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, excessive interviewing isn't allowed.
Special Week-san,
please head on into the room ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
Well then—...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —...It's Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan... Ah!
It really is Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right!
Tsuyoshi-san is running in the Kyoto Daishoten too!
Could it have something to do with—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hold it! Stop right there! Special Week-san, get inside.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah...
E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text:
Eeeee!? Please wait!
Just one word! Just let me say one word~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...Incredible. The sheer volume of media coverage for Spe-chan is overwhelming..."

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: (Glint!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Um... Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi-san?
Do you~ have a moment~...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeees～!
And so, under the blazing sun, a hectic summer began.
